evidence: Plaut. Most. 41: quid vīs fierī? nōn omnēs possunt olēre unguenta exōtica
terms.comment: Literally “what do you want to happen?”: comedy’s shrug at what cannot be helped.

sources: Lewis & Short: fio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 97, 311.
Plautus, Mostellaria 41, Aulularia 741 and Amphitruo 702, checked against the Perseus Latin texts.

phrases.latin: Quid vīs fierī? factum est illud: fierī īnfectum nōn potest.
phrases.english: What do you expect? It’s done: it can’t be undone.
